## 🌎 Geopolitics

### Russia Launches Record Energy Strike as Abu Dhabi Talks Near

Russia's military struck Ukraine's energy infrastructure with 289 drones, 17 ballistic missiles, and 59 cruise missiles on November 3rd—the U.S. election day—marking its largest coordinated assault on Ukraine's power grid this year. The escalation precedes trilateral talks between the U.S., Ukraine, and Russia scheduled for Abu Dhabi on November 10-11, led by Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner—the first diplomatic round since talks were suspended in February. Moscow's timing signals intent to establish battlefield advantage before any negotiation.

**Why it matters.** The collision between military escalation and renewed diplomacy shapes energy markets and supply chains globally. Russia's targeting of Ukraine's power systems risks broader electromagnetic disruption that could cascade into rare-earth and semiconductor supply chains India depends on. For anyone with exposure to energy markets, defence equity, or geopolitical arbitrage, the next 72 hours—whether Abu Dhabi talks move the needle or Moscow demonstrates continued dominance—will determine whether winter 2026 risks a major disruption or locks in a temporary floor.

**Action.** Monitor the Abu Dhabi talks November 10-11 closely; track whether the U.S. announces any concessions on Ukraine's NATO path or territorial shape, which would move commodity and equity markets. Watch energy prices for sustained pressure, and keep a window on rare-earth supply forecasts. Read any framework announcement carefully before betting on stability.

*Sources: [laymangeopolitics.substack.com](https://laymangeopolitics.substack.com/p/lay-of-the-land-november-6th-2026) · [justsecurity.org](https://justsecurity.org/163619/early-edition-november-6-2026)*

### Iran Nuclear Proposal Arrives as Trump Weighs Military Options

Iran delivered a nuclear proposal to the United States via Qatar on November 5-6, conditioning discussions on seven demands tied to reopening the Strait of Hormuz. President Trump, speaking after a meeting with his national security advisers, said he would decide "soon" whether to resume military action in the Iran conflict, now that the U.S. midterm elections are concluded. The timing signals Tehran's attempt to use the post-election political window to reset negotiations before Washington makes its next military move.

**Why it matters.** Iran's nuclear proposal and the Strait of Hormuz linkage shape global oil markets and India's energy security directly. Any disruption to Strait traffic cascades into energy costs that compress margins across India's manufacturing, transport, and power sectors. For quant traders and consultants tracking commodity markets or energy equity exposure, the next two weeks—whether Trump moves militarily or engages diplomatically—will determine whether oil trades in a tight band or faces spike risk. India's oil import bill and rupee stability are hostage to how this play unfolds.

**Action.** Track Trump's next statement on Iran policy closely; watch oil futures for any premium buildup as the market prices conflict risk. Monitor the Strait of Hormuz for any Iranian military exercises or U.S. naval movements. If talks advance, watch for any concessions on U.S. economic sanctions, which would flow directly into global energy repricing.

*Sources: [justsecurity.org](https://justsecurity.org/163619/early-edition-november-6-2026) · [laymangeopolitics.substack.com](https://laymangeopolitics.substack.com/p/lay-of-the-land-november-6th-2026)*

## 🧠 Artificial Intelligence

### xAI Embeds Invisible Watermarks in All Grok API Text Starting Today

Starting November 7, 2026, xAI is automatically embedding machine-readable invisible watermarks into text from seven Grok models (grok-4.7, 4.6, 4.5, 4.3, and three grok-4.20 variants) on the API. The watermark alters word selection during generation to create a hidden signal, survives copy-paste, and is enabled by default with no code changes. xAI cites EU AI Act Article 50, which mandates machine-readable marking of AI-generated content, positioning this as compliance ahead of December 2 enforcement.

**Why it matters.** This is the first visible enforcement of the EU AI Act's marking requirement at the API level. For teams using Grok in production, the watermark changes output determinism—the same prompt may generate slightly different text depending on watermark injection, affecting reproducibility in testing and A/B experiments. The architecture choice (invisible, per-word modification rather than metadata tags) is novel: it persists through text transformations that strip headers but carries a trade-off: developers can't easily verify watermark presence without deepseek-style decoding, and the statistical signature may leak information about your inputs to adversaries performing membership inference.

**Action.** If you deploy Grok in production, audit your test suites for determinism assumptions and verify whether your observability captures watermark-induced variance. If legal liability matters to your org, review xAI's opt-out policy (reports conflict on the mechanism—check their developer docs directly). Study how the watermark interacts with your retrieval-augmented generation pipeline: does the watermark persist through vector embedding, summary generation, or downstream LLM re-paraphrasing? The answer determines whether it survives your inference stack.

*Sources: [x.com](https://x.com/IntCyberDigest/status/2117015073323733296) · [neuralbrew.ai](https://neuralbrew.ai/en/articles/2026/11/xai-grok-api-text-watermarking-november-7/) · [supergrok.info](https://supergrok.info/blog/grok-api-text-watermark)*

### OpenAI's GPT-6 Cyber Reaches 48.5% on Exploit Benchmarks, Rated Critical Risk

OpenAI released GPT-6 Cyber on November 5, 2026, a frontier model for authorized vulnerability research, achieving 48.5% on ExploitGym (a 51% absolute gain over GPT-5.6 Cyber's 32.1%). The model discovered 948 privilege-escalation vulnerabilities in Linux, 81 high-severity Firefox bugs, and identified 304 critical issues now reported to maintainers. Access is gated through Daybreak Red; OpenAI rates it Critical under its Preparedness Framework due to stronger offensive capabilities paired with new alignment safeguards.

**Why it matters.** This marks a capability jump in AI-assisted vulnerability discovery—moving from shallow pattern-matching to sustained multi-step exploitation. For security teams, the 51% benchmark gain suggests GPT-6 Cyber could accelerate zero-day hunting workflows, but the Critical rating signals OpenAI is taking the dual-use risk seriously. The scoping discipline metric (99.93% stay within bounds without prompts) is a useful signal that frontier offensive capabilities can be constrained; however, the model's effectiveness on real bugs means an exploit could now exist before your patch is ready. Architecturally, this unlocks agentic security research: multi-turn reasoning over code, test-and-retry cycles, and the ability to reason about privilege escalation chains.

**Action.** If you're in cybersecurity, request access to the Daybreak Red program. Run your own codebase through a fuzzer-to-GPT-6-Cyber pipeline on a closed network and benchmark time-to-first-bug against your current SAST/fuzzing stack. Revisit your patching SLA: if GPT-6 Cyber can find 80+ bugs in a codebase you maintain, your mean-time-to-patch needs to be aggressive. Read OpenAI's system card and the external assessments (NIST CAISSI, Irregular) to understand the alignment architecture—this is a working model of how to pair frontier capabilities with oversight.

*Sources: [x.com](https://x.com/OpenAI/status/2118390190246879554) · [securityweek.com](https://www.securityweek.com/openai-says-new-gpt-6-cyber-model-hunts-flaws-without-crossing-the-line/) · [deploymentsafety.openai.com](https://deploymentsafety.openai.com/gpt-6-cyber)*

## 🇮🇳 India

### GIVA Jewellery Closes ₹975 Crore Investment from Multiples PE, Largest in India's Lab-Grown Diamond Sector

Bengaluru-based fine jewellery brand GIVA has raised over $100 million (₹975 crore) in a funding round led by Multiples Alternate Asset Management, the largest single investment in India's new-age jewellery market. Multiples secures a board seat alongside co-investors Epiq Capital and Edelweiss Discovery Fund. Early-stage backers India Quotient and Sixth Sense Ventures partially exited while retaining minority stakes. The round closes as GIVA targets 160 new retail stores in FY27 and expands manufacturing capacity.

**Why it matters.** India's lab-grown diamond and fine jewellery segment is maturing past direct-to-consumer, and institutional PE capital flowing into omnichannel expansion signals that the model scales. For AI/deeptech founders, this demonstrates how specialised verticals—jewellery, beauty, apparel—absorb VC money when they build defensible logistics and supply-chain tech, not just digital brands. Multiples' board seat and the retailer's store-expansion focus over pure e-commerce show that physical-retail density and manufacturing automation drive returns in India's luxury market.

**Action.** Pull Multiples' recent portfolio (portfolio.multiples.vc) to track which D2C/commerce verticals are attracting mega-rounds. Monitor GIVA's quarterly store growth and profitability filings once available; a playbook for scaling lab-grown to 1000+ stores (their stated 5-year target) informs India's broader retail tech strategy. Subscribe to the Indian Jeweller industry updates for supply-chain announcements.

*Sources: [[YourStory: Jewellery brand GIVA raises $100M from Multiples PE](https://yourstory.com/2026/11/jewellery-brand-giva-raises-100-million-from-multiples-pe)]([YourStory: Jewellery brand GIVA raises $100M from Multiples PE](https://yourstory.com/2026/11/jewellery-brand-giva-raises-100-million-from-multiples-pe)) · [[Inc42: GIVA Raises ₹975 Cr Led By Multiples PE, Eyes 160 New Stores In FY27](https://inc42.com/buzz/giva-raises-₹975-cr-led-by-multiples-pe-eyes-160-new-stores-in-fy27/)]([Inc42: GIVA Raises ₹975 Cr Led By Multiples PE, Eyes 160 New Stores In FY27](https://inc42.com/buzz/giva-raises-₹975-cr-led-by-multiples-pe-eyes-160-new-stores-in-fy27/)) · [[BW Retail World: GIVA Raises Over $100 Mn, Targets 1,000 Stores In Five Years](https://bwretailworld.com/sector/fashion-lifestyle/jewellery/giva-raises-over-100-million-targets-1000-stores-in-five-years)]([BW Retail World: GIVA Raises Over $100 Mn, Targets 1,000 Stores In Five Years](https://bwretailworld.com/sector/fashion-lifestyle/jewellery/giva-raises-over-100-million-targets-1000-stores-in-five-years))*

### EloElo Group Raises $80 Million Series C Led by Hornbill Capital and NBCUniversal to Scale AI Microdrama Platform

Entertainment AI startup EloElo Group closed an $80 million Series C on November 3–4, 2026, led by Hornbill Capital and Hollywood major NBCUniversal. The round values the company's total raise at approximately $130 million. EloElo's flagship Story TV app has accrued over 40 million monthly active users and operates alongside content platforms Dolphin AI, Master learning app, and Voxy AI. Series B was $13.5 million in April 2025, led by Play Ventures.

**Why it matters.** US media conglomerates entering Indian consumer AI funding signals that content-generation and user-engagement tech are now strategic assets for legacy entertainment. For AI engineers, this validates two trends: (1) microdrama and short-form AI-generated content platforms absorb institutional capital at scale, and (2) founders who lock in large creator communities early can command strategic rounds from Silicon Valley and Hollywood. Story TV's 40M MAU is a beachhead; whoever can monetise creator economics and licensing in India first owns a moat.

**Action.** Follow EloElo's Series C deployment via their founder announcements and product updates—watch for international expansion and monetisation milestones. Track how NBCUniversal integrates Indian micro-content into its global catalogue (IP licensing is where the arbitrage appears). If building in creator tools or shortform content, benchmark EloElo's unit economics and Creator Fund sizing against Luminous, Vedo, and other platforms raising similar cheques.

## 🏗 Tech & Startups

### Shield AI Acquires Radar Maker Echodyne for $5.3B, Hits $28.8B Valuation

Autonomous vehicle startup Shield AI announced November 5 that it agreed to acquire radar maker Echodyne for up to $5.3 billion, with $4.8 billion due at close and up to $500 million in performance earnouts. Shield is raising $2.5 billion, including a $1 billion Series H led by Blackstone and JPMorgan Chase, valuing the San Francisco company at $28.8 billion post-money. Kirkland, Washington-based Echodyne, backed by Bill Gates' Breakthrough Energy Ventures, brings counter-drone radar capabilities to Shield's platform.

**Why it matters.** Shield's capital velocity and acquisition strategy reveal the autonomous defense playbook: bolt hardware sensors onto software-driven platforms once core autonomy scales. Counter-drone radars offer both margin and defensible IP where generic autonomy stacks commoditize. For robotics and aerospace founders, the deal validates hardware acquisition paths at scale; the standalone operating unit structure signals confidence in existing engineering teams over greenfield integration.

**Action.** Monitor the early-2027 close and Shield's first post-integration customer announcements for revenue signals. Echodyne's standing as a standalone unit gives founders a template for negotiating autonomy in hardware acquisitions. Check Blackstone's defense-tech portfolio for follow-on consolidation bets in autonomous systems.

*Sources: [[Washington Technology](https://www.washingtontechnology.com/companies/2026/11/shield-ai-acquires-radar-maker-echodyne-53-billion-deal/417086/)]([Washington Technology](https://www.washingtontechnology.com/companies/2026/11/shield-ai-acquires-radar-maker-echodyne-53-billion-deal/417086/)) · [[GeekWire](https://www.geekwire.com/2026/shield-ai-to-buy-bill-gates-backed-radar-maker-echodyne-in-5-3b-deal-doubling-down-on-seattle-area/)]([GeekWire](https://www.geekwire.com/2026/shield-ai-to-buy-bill-gates-backed-radar-maker-echodyne-in-5-3b-deal-doubling-down-on-seattle-area/)) · [[Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-05-shield-ai-to-hit-28-8-billion-value-with-5-3-billion-radar-acquisition)]([Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-05-shield-ai-to-hit-28-8-billion-value-with-5-3-billion-radar-acquisition))*

### Humble Robotics Raises $51M Series A for Autonomous Freight Under 250 Miles

Autonomous freight startup Humble Robotics closed a $51 million Series A on November 5, led by Obvious Ventures with participation from Eclipse and Energy Impact Partners. Total funding now reaches $75 million for the San Francisco company, which emerged from stealth only in April 2026 with its cabless, electric Humble Hauler. The round targets customer pilots on regional drayage and warehouse runs, where routes under 250 miles account for 87 percent of U.S. truck tonnage.

**Why it matters.** A $51M Series A for a pre-revenue robotics company signals venture confidence in long-hardware timelines when unit economics and regulatory pathways look clear. Humble's modular platform approach (multiple vehicles on one architecture) mirrors Tesla's strategy and spreads per-model engineering costs. For deeptech founders pitching capital-intensive plays, this validates that customer pilots and credible engineering can unlock institutional rounds before revenue if the 12-month regulatory and pilot timeline is realistic.

**Action.** Track Humble's customer pilot outcomes through the August 2027 target, watching for port authority partnerships and state regulatory clearances as the real constraint. Study Obvious Ventures' deeptech thesis; this lead suggests conviction beyond one bet. The modular platform claim is a red flag to verify—if pilots reveal integration costs, future raises will compress valuation.

*Sources: [[Morningstar/Business Wire](https://www.morningstar.com/news/business-wire/20261105576352/humble-robotics-raises-51-million-series-a-to-scale-its-unified-approach-to-autonomous-and-electric-freight-vehicles)]([Morningstar/Business Wire](https://www.morningstar.com/news/business-wire/20261105576352/humble-robotics-raises-51-million-series-a-to-scale-its-unified-approach-to-autonomous-and-electric-freight-vehicles)) · [[FreightWaves](https://www.freightwaves.com/news/humble-robotics-51m-series-a-cabless-hauler)]([FreightWaves](https://www.freightwaves.com/news/humble-robotics-51m-series-a-cabless-hauler)) · [[Unite.ai](https://www.unite.ai/humble-robotics-raises-51m-series-a-to-advance-autonomous-freight/)]([Unite.ai](https://www.unite.ai/humble-robotics-raises-51m-series-a-to-advance-autonomous-freight/))*

## 🩹 Health & Science

### First human trial of chemogenetic epilepsy gene therapy achieves 92% seizure reduction

Chinese neurosurgeons implanted a modified adeno-associated virus into the hippocampus of three men with drug-resistant temporal-lobe epilepsy, enabling their brain cells to express a chemically engineered receptor. When paired with low-dose oral clozapine, this receptor allows the drug to selectively dampen seizure-generating tissue. The three patients (ages 28–37) had average monthly seizure counts drop 92.6% over follow-up, with only grade 1–2 side effects. One patient experienced breakthrough seizures when clozapine was accidentally discontinued, confirming the mechanism's on-demand nature.

**Why it matters.** This is the first human evidence that a chemogenetic strategy—previously shown only in animals—can safely reduce intractable seizures in a reversible, medication-controlled manner. Drug-resistant epilepsy affects 30% of the ~50 million people with epilepsy globally; current surgical options carry cognitive and hemorrhage risks. A tool that targets only hyperactive neurons and responds to an inert low-dose drug opens a new design principle for circuit-level neuromodulation in humans. At least seven additional Chinese trials testing chemogenetics for Parkinson's and neuropathic pain are now enrolling, signaling commercial appetite for the platform.

**Action.** Read the NEJM letter (Dai et al., *Chemogenetic Neuromodulation for Refractory Epilepsy*, Nov 4, 2026 online) to understand the surgical technique, imaging protocol, and clozapine dose. Check ClinicalTrials.gov for enrollment in analogous trials outside China (as of now, most are in Beijing). For investors and biotech founders, this validates DREADDs (Designer Receptors Exclusively Activated by Designer Drugs) as a clinical modality; licensing opportunities are likely to emerge around AAV delivery, receptor engineering, and outpatient clozapine protocols.

*Sources: [[NEJM Chemogenetic Neuromodulation](https://www.nejm.org/doi/full/10.1056/NEJMc2606815)]([NEJM Chemogenetic Neuromodulation](https://www.nejm.org/doi/full/10.1056/NEJMc2606815)) · [[Nature: Epileptic seizures nearly vanish after gene therapy](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-026-03566-2)]([Nature: Epileptic seizures nearly vanish after gene therapy](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-026-03566-2)) · [[Science: Novel gene therapy lets drug dampen brain cell activity](https://www.science.org/content/article/novel-gene-therapy-lets-drug-dampen-brain-cell-activity-reducing-seizures)]([Science: Novel gene therapy lets drug dampen brain cell activity](https://www.science.org/content/article/novel-gene-therapy-lets-drug-dampen-brain-cell-activity-reducing-seizures))*

### Povetacicept cuts urinary protein loss by 52% in IgA nephropathy phase 3 trial

Vertex Pharmaceuticals' RAINIER phase 3 trial randomized 199 patients with biopsy-confirmed IgA nephropathy (the most common primary glomerulonephritis globally) to either 80 mg subcutaneous povetacicept every four weeks or placebo, with all participants on stable background antiviral therapy. At the week-36 interim analysis, the povetacicept arm achieved a 52% reduction in proteinuria versus 4.3% in placebo. Serious adverse events occurred in 3% of the drug arm and 4% of placebo; the most frequent side effects were grade 1–2. The FDA has set a PDUFA date of November 30, 2026 for potential accelerated approval.

**Why it matters.** IgA nephropathy is the leading cause of rapidly progressive kidney disease in Asia and increasingly in the West; 20–30% progress to end-stage renal disease within a decade despite current therapy. Povetacicept is a B-cell activating factor (BAFF) and A proliferation-inducing ligand (APRIL) inhibitor that targets the root of the pathogenic IgA1-dominant immune response. The 52% proteinuria reduction in an interim population signals a disease-modifying effect beyond symptom management. Accelerated approval would unlock revenue and real-world evidence; the full trial data (expected in 2027) will determine whether this translates to slowed kidney-function decline and reduced dialysis-free survival hazard.

**Action.** Nephrologists should review the NEJM paper (Barratt et al., *Interim Analysis of a Phase 3 Trial of Povetacicept in IgA Nephropathy*, NEJM Oct 23, 2026) to understand the population, primary endpoint (proteinuria response), and safety profile. Biotech and pharma executives building IgA nephropathy pipelines should monitor the November 30 FDA decision and 2027 efficacy data; if accelerated approval succeeds, a template emerges for BAFF/APRIL inhibitors in other antibody-mediated glomerulonephritides. Patients on clinical trial waitlists should discuss trial enrollment windows with their nephrologists before November 30.

*Sources: [[NEJM Interim Analysis of Povetacicept](https://www.nejm.org/doi/abs/10.1056/NEJMoa2608682)]([NEJM Interim Analysis of Povetacicept](https://www.nejm.org/doi/abs/10.1056/NEJMoa2608682)) · [[Vertex Press Release: Phase 3 RAINIER Results](https://news.vrtx.com/news-releases/news-release-details/phase-3-rainier-results-supporting-best-class-potential)]([Vertex Press Release: Phase 3 RAINIER Results](https://news.vrtx.com/news-releases/news-release-details/phase-3-rainier-results-supporting-best-class-potential)) · [[AJMC: Povetacicept Cuts Proteinuria by 52%](https://www.ajmc.com/view/povetacicept-cuts-proteinuria-by-52-in-iga-nephropathy-at-week-36)]([AJMC: Povetacicept Cuts Proteinuria by 52%](https://www.ajmc.com/view/povetacicept-cuts-proteinuria-by-52-in-iga-nephropathy-at-week-36))*

## 🎤 Culture & World

### Godzilla Minus Zero opens globally with historic simultaneous Japan and North America rollout

Takashi Yamazaki's *Godzilla Minus Zero*, the sequel to his Oscar-winning *Godzilla Minus One*, opened November 3 in Japan on Godzilla Day (the anniversary of the 1954 original) and November 6 across North America via GKIDS. This marks the 39th entry in the franchise and the first time a Japan-produced Godzilla film has launched simultaneously in both territories, signaling a shift in how prestige anime/kaiju content reaches Western audiences.

**Why it matters.** The staggered-release problem has plagued anime tentpoles for years. Simultaneous worldwide availability eliminates fan piracy windows and prevents spoiler decay on social media. If *Minus Zero* performs, it proves the distribution model works for prestige animation at scale, potentially reshaping how studios greenlight and release international tentpoles. Vercel's own infrastructure stack touches this layer—GKIDS' theatrical scheduling is a data point for how creator economy and distribution trends converge.

**Action.** Monitor opening-weekend box office across territories (Japan vs. North America) to see if simultaneous release cannibalizes or amplifies total gross. Check whether Western critics treat this as tentpole or prestige cinema—that framing determines future funding. Yamazaki's stated intention to conclude the "Minus" arc here matters for franchise signal; listen for announcements about what's next.

*Sources: [[The Outer Haven](https://www.theouterhaven.net/2026/01/godzilla-minus-zero-to-be-released-by-gkids-in-the-us-on-november-6)]([The Outer Haven](https://www.theouterhaven.net/2026/01/godzilla-minus-zero-to-be-released-by-gkids-in-the-us-on-november-6)) · [[Godzilla.com](https://godzilla.com/blogs/news/godzilla-minus-zero-confirmed-for-north-american-theatrical-release-on-november-6)]([Godzilla.com](https://godzilla.com/blogs/news/godzilla-minus-zero-confirmed-for-north-american-theatrical-release-on-november-6)) · [[Dread Central](https://www.dreadcentral.com/news/553528/godzilla-minus-zero-stomps-into-theaters-november-2026)]([Dread Central](https://www.dreadcentral.com/news/553528/godzilla-minus-zero-stomps-into-theaters-november-2026))*

### Dove Cameron ships debut album *Final Girl* on November 6, signaling Disney-to-independent pivot

Dove Cameron released *Final Girl*, her debut studio album, on November 6, 2026, via Disruptor and Columbia. The 11-track album features singles "When in Rome" and "Do the Math," with the title drawing on horror cinema as a metaphor for survival and reclaiming agency. Cameron is simultaneously touring with Sombr, including a November 6 show in Indianapolis.

**Why it matters.** Child-star pivots to music are routine noise, but Cameron's timing and positioning matter. The album title literally inverts the damsel-in-distress trope; the singles' lyrical content ("do the math," victim mentality takedown) reads as direct commentary on parasocial baggage and growth beyond her Disney origins. For consumer-tech: this is a case study in artist-owned narrative control through thematic coherence. Thealbum and tour launch happen simultaneously—a playbook increasingly adopted by creators who own their distribution channels (streaming + direct ticketing).

**Action.** Track whether *Final Girl* gains playlist momentum on Spotify/Apple Music in weeks 1–2 (particularly outside the Disney-adjacent younger demographic). Follow whether music press picks up the album as a credible indie pop statement or dismisses it as Disney product rebranding. Note if her tour with Sombr becomes a draw that sustains post-release.

*Sources: [[Melodic Mag](https://www.melodicmag.com/news/album-announcements/dove-cameron-debut-album-final-girl/)]([Melodic Mag](https://www.melodicmag.com/news/album-announcements/dove-cameron-debut-album-final-girl/)) · [[Ratings Game Music](https://ratingsgamemusic.com/2026/10/22/dove-cameron-takes-down-victim-mentality-on-new-do-the-math/)]([Ratings Game Music](https://ratingsgamemusic.com/2026/10/22/dove-cameron-takes-down-victim-mentality-on-new-do-the-math/)) · [[The Music Universe](https://themusicuniverse.com/?p=162264)]([The Music Universe](https://themusicuniverse.com/?p=162264))*
